question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ludicrous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Wise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ludicrous **means ridiculous or absurd. (हास्यास्पद या बेतुका)

 
 
• **Example**: *The idea that pigs could fly seemed ludicrous, prompting laughter from the audience.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of ludicrous is **wise**, which means ha
